licenses.scope: CUDA subtree only; no root license covers the HeadKV Python, shell, profiles, or data tree

environment_findings.evidence: the complete tree contains no requirements, lock, pyproject, or environment file
setup.py declares package name adakv version 0.0.1 and only discovers packages; it declares no dependencies
monkeypatch.py names Transformers 4.37 as tested but warns rather than fails for every other version
csrc/dist stores Linux x86_64 eggs for Python 3.8 and 3.12; their build environment and binary provenance are not locked
README and shell scripts enumerate many CUDA devices, background jobs, relative output paths, and fixed model identifiers without a resource or environment manifest

runtime_findings.evidence: headkv/monkeypatch.py replaces global Llama/Mistral model, FlashAttention, and generation-preparation methods
headkv/snapkv_utils.py imports tiny_api_cuda during cache updates
ReasonSnapKVCluster loads one of four relative JSON profiles for only the named Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B checkpoints
the global pool uses floor division with floating beta and independently rounds each head capacity; no post-round total-budget conservation assertion is declared
the tree has no test directory or assertion-based suite; test.sh launches a ReasonKV BABILong experiment

model_and_data_findings.evidence: the Mistral tokenizer alone uses an immutable revision in some runners; model weights and Llama tokenizer/model loads have no immutable revision
retrieval_head_detection_r2.py enables trust_remote_code for some tokenizers/configs/models
376 data-like files include LongBench JSONL and serialized BABILong Arrow datasets without a source revision, derivation manifest, checksum manifest, or root rights file
four committed head-score JSON files are loaded directly, but no machine-readable record binds each profile to exact code, model, tokenizer, prompts, and generated outputs
beta is swept across eight values and selected on a stated 15 percent validation split, but the repository provides no checked split/provenance artifact comparable to Speck contracts

clean_room_requirements: resolve rights for HeadKV Python/shell/profile/data artifacts independently of the csrc license
pin an environment and all native source/build inputs without using committed eggs
freeze model/tokenizer revisions and disable remote code
reconstruct profile examples and head scores from a source-hashed deterministic manifest
define a conservation-safe global layer/head apportionment oracle before reproducing the beta sweep
qualify model patching and cache behavior against an unmodified dense reference
materialize BABILong and LongBench only through separately qualified source/rights adapters
compare correct-answer-span importance against conjunctive required-source labels without importing upstream implementation

decision.next_action: retain HeadKV-R2 as a mandatory conceptual baseline; do not execute or reuse its tree unless rights, environment, model/data/profile provenance, conservation, and behavior contracts are independently resolved
